summary: Example NETCONF task sets IOS-XR hostname, domain name and domain search list with iosxr_system.
questions: How do I set the hostname and domain on IOS-XR?

answer_card.title: Set IOS-XR hostname and domain
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Configure hostname and domain-name
  cisco.iosxr.iosxr_system:
    hostname: iosxr01
    domain_name: test.example.com
    domain_search:
      - ansible.com
      - redhat.com
      - cisco.com
```
